blocking.fix: Write the probe lines above as failing cases first: parse cases, plus one composed case with the demoted second item. Then make the reason an allowlist too. Each part after punctuation must be a closed done clause: an optional subject, then is/are/was/were/has been, then a DONE_WORD; or each/every/all/both ... DONE_WORD; or 'nothing remains'. It must have no qualifier (partly, partially, mostly, half, nearly, almost, largely, some, most, N%, 'N of the') and no exception or condition (apart from, other than, save for, bar, besides, aside from, short of, minus, once, after, when, if, until, unless, as soon as). Anything else is work. Let a whole-set 'nothing' demote other items only when its reason passes that strict form. Correct the ADR amendment point 3 and runtime.md to match.
